settings.about.description: A read-only companion for navlistener GNSS observers.

settings.audience.note: Only audiences returned by this collector can be selected. My Stations and live-event resume state stay separate for each selection.
settings.notifications.note: Alerts cover confirmed live transitions while this app is active. Initial snapshots and replay do not alert. There is no background monitoring when the app is suspended or closed. Critical alerts also cover critical offline and RF events.
settings.server.credential_note: Optional read token. Never enter a feeder, ATECC, or GNF1 credential.
settings.server.credential_saved: A server-scoped read credential is saved in Keychain. Leave this blank to reuse it.
settings.server.logout: Sign Out and Use Public Access
settings.server.tls_note: HTTPS uses system trust. Install an on-site CA through Apple platform policy; TLS verification is never disabled.

board.atecc.note: Boot diagnostics only. A screening pass does not certify entropy or establish device enrollment.
board.atecc.title: Security chip boot checks
board.diagnostics.title: Board diagnostics
board.eeprom.note: This identifies the manifest EEPROM. The authenticated station ID remains the collector identity.
board.eeprom.title: Manifest EEPROM
board.environment.note: Temperatures come from separate sensors. Pressure has no sea-level correction. A dash means no valid measurement.
board.environment.title: Board environment
board.freshness.receipt_only: Recent receipt · sample UTC and replay age unknown
board.interference.note: Receiver indications include alarm and recovery transitions. Reports may combine several transitions, and the preceding sample may be minutes older. This context does not change the collector’s integrity verdict.
board.interference.title: Latest receiver interference context
board.resources.note: This RAM buffer is lost on reboot. Dropped records were lost; queue depth does not establish collector persistence.
board.resources.title: Buffer and memory
board.rtc.note: Flags describe the last RTC read. Backup enabled does not confirm a battery is installed or working.
board.rtc.title: Real-time clock
board.sample.title: Sample identity
board.timing.note: Periods are measured against the ESP APB clock. Positive error means a longer period. Wrapped phase is modulo one second and does not measure UTC accuracy. Values describe this sample; counters retain history.
board.timing.title: GNSS and RTC pulse timing
setup.collector.note: Use the collector’s feeder hostname and TLS port, which may differ from the app’s read API address. Enter the station ID and ingest token assigned by your operator.
setup.collector.title: Collector enrollment
setup.confirm.pending: Waiting for a new boot to appear at the collector. Allow the observer to restart, then check again.
setup.confirm.private_required: Automatic confirmation needs an authorized private collector connection established before setup. Check the enrolled station in your collector if that connection is unavailable.
setup.confirm.success: New observer boot confirmed at the collector.
setup.confirm.title: Collector confirmation
setup.disconnected_pending: Bluetooth disconnected after Wi-Fi configuration. Collector confirmation is still required.
setup.error.camera: The camera scanner is unavailable. Allow camera access in Settings or enter the device name and password from the label.
setup.error.config: Check the collector host (1–63 ASCII bytes), TLS port (1–65535), station ID (1–32 ASCII bytes), enrollment token (1–128 ASCII bytes), and Wi-Fi settings.
setup.error.connection: Could not connect to the observer. Check Bluetooth, device power, and the setup label, then reconnect.
setup.error.incompatible: The device does not offer Security 2 and the required NavListen setup capability.
setup.error.label: This is not a valid ESP32-S3 setup label. Check the device name and 12-character password on the physical label.
setup.error.power_cycle: Configuration was saved, but the observer could not schedule its restart. Power-cycle it, then check the collector.
setup.error.response: The observer returned an invalid setup response. Reconnect and try again.
setup.error.save: The observer could not save its configuration. You can retry.
setup.error.timeout: The observer did not respond in time. Reconnect to retry, or check the collector if it has restarted.
setup.error.wifi: The observer could not verify Wi-Fi. Check the network name and password and try again.
setup.introduction: Power the observer and keep its setup label nearby. Bluetooth setup is available while the observer is unprovisioned.
setup.label.name: Device name
setup.label.not_saved: No setup password is saved for this device name.
setup.label.remember: Remember setup password on this device
setup.label.title: Physical setup label
setup.recovery.instructions: If Bluetooth setup is unavailable, join the observer’s navfeeder-XXYYZZ Wi-Fi network using the password on its label, then open the setup portal. Holding BOOT for eight seconds clears operating settings and preserves the setup password.
setup.recovery.title: Browser recovery
setup.title: Set up an observer
setup.tokens_note: The physical setup password, observer enrollment token, and collector read token have separate purposes.
setup.wifi.title: Observer Wi-Fi
setup.error.tunnel: Check the WireGuard profile: one [Interface] and one [Peer], an IPv4 Address, an Endpoint host:port, and AllowedIPs naming the collector’s single /32.
setup.error.tunnel_late: The observer saved its configuration before the tunnel profile arrived. Reconnect and set up again, sending the profile first.
setup.error.tunnel_unsupported: This observer’s firmware has no WireGuard support. Update it, or leave the profile empty to connect over the public endpoint.
setup.tunnel.note: Paste the WireGuard .conf your collector operator gave you. AllowedIPs is the collector’s address inside the tunnel. Leave empty to connect over the public endpoint.
setup.tunnel.title: Secure tunnel (optional)
update.title: Software Update
update.development: Development device: production security has not been locked.
update.open: Open device: unlocked hardware following the open release track.
update.requested: Request recorded. Waiting for the device.
update.watch_status: Request sent. Follow the device state above for download, reboot and confirmation.
